note: Tutorial summary page 5: Twin Spirit Commands

blocks.text: ● {o|Twin Spirit Commands} are Spirit Commands that only the main pilots can use, when the unit is a Twin Unit of 2 machines.
● Twin Spirit Commands are used with the {o|"Spirit"} unit command, and are marked {i:twin}.

● Like Spirit Commands they cost SP (Spirit Points), but a Twin Spirit Command needs SP from both main pilots of the Twin Unit. Each pilot holds 1 of the 42 Twin Spirit Commands. The SP cost of the same command differs by pilot.
